residents.name: Krish
residents.notes: non-veg (chicken bone-in medium cut, mutton, egg, pork sausage); no prawns (deep-fry hassle); dislikes potato; plain dosa over masala dosa; cucumber raita only; likes kothu paratha, chapathi + bhindi, egg curry, egg+chicken hakka noodles, noodles + mutton pepper curry, garlic bread, vegetable pulao, puliyogare, rice-sambar-poriyal; tracks chicken pieces closely; household serves 3 per meal

cook.name: Amudha Akka / Kalaiarasi
cook.schedule: Twice a day; dinner at home is non-negotiable even when Krish travels; no cook on Sundays (plan soaking/marination before the Sun-Mon gap)
notes: Mangalore-style (neer dosa, chicken chukka/sukka) and Chettinad (fresh-ground pepper/coriander masala) are the hiring basis.
Kitchen floor and sink must be left clean before leaving.
Quantity control matters - biryani chicken shortfall and 'too much made' both drew complaints.

person_rules.note: Reduce capsicum quantity generally; pulao veg mix = peas, capsicum, beans, carrot without overloading.
Liked dishes on record; vegetable pulao rated excellent.

dish_keyword_rules.note: Cucumber raita only - avoid onion raita or cucumber-onion raita.
Plain dosa preferred over masala/vegetable dosa.

frequency_caps.name: Mutton
frequency_caps.note: Mutton in rotation (pepper curry) - protein should be the star, less onion/veg.

brand_rules.note: Meat only from New Frosty's, fresh - never online/frozen meat platforms.
Milk: Full Cream 1 L pack only.

ingredient_grade_rules.rule: Bone-in, medium cut preferred; biryani must have a generous chicken-to-rice ratio.
No plain/steamed rice; flavoured rice only (tomato rice, garlic rice, pulao) as an occasional exception; pulao uses jeera rice, not basmati. Meals are eaten with rotis/parathas/chapati.
Banned in Section 1; if ever used, never spicy (conflict - excluded).
Used sparingly (small packets); Chettinad chicken masala ground fresh (whole pepper + coriander seeds). Salt is dish-specific: chicken needs more, neer dosa less.

breakfast_style: Rotate across dosa (plain), idli, poha, eggs, kara bath, English breakfast (pork sausage), shakshuka - never one item repeatedly; sambar/coconut chutney with South Indian breakfasts.

cooking_technique.gravy: Semi-gravy or dry - avoid thin/watery gravies
cooking_technique.variety: Lunch needs rotation - kebab, achari, salad, pasta-style lunches on file
cooking_technique.salt: Dish-specific - chicken more, neer dosa less; spicy chicken stays separable from a plain dosa
cooking_technique.garlic_bread: Toast with butter, not from-scratch garlic butter bread
cooking_technique.fried_rice: Needs day-old cooled rice - schedule accordingly

standing_instructions: Dinner must be prepared at home every day, even if Krish is travelling part of the day.
Default 3 servings per meal; adjust when Krish flags a different headcount.
No plain rice; flavoured rice occasionally; meals with roti/paratha.
No MSG / artificial colour in anything cooked or ordered.
Meat fresh from New Frosty's only; Krish tracks chicken pieces used/remaining.
'No North Indian dishes' is a standing AVOID but Krish keeps ordering aloo/methi paratha, chole, poori - CONFIRM (kept soft here).
Kitchen floor and sink clean before the cook leaves; poori wrapped in foil when served.
Meal plans twice weekly (Sun for Mon-Wed, Wed for Thu-Fri); changes locked by 8 PM the evening before.
Daily morning pantry photos; praise as well as complaints relayed to the cook.
non_negotiables: Meat only from New Frosty's, only fresh.
Cauliflower never spicy (excluded here as banned).
notes: Conflicts to confirm: 'no North Indian dishes' vs repeated orders; cauliflower banned vs 'never spicy'/'optional in pulao'; fridge-instead-of-discard for leftover lunch (Sep 22).
'No dal' is enforced by dish keywords (dal/daal/pappu/kadhi/rajma/chole); sambar and rasam remain allowed because Krish likes rice-sambar-poriyal.
Pork is liked but the repo has no pork dishes.
